name: Suspicious Mstsc.EXE Execution With Local RDP File
description: Detects potential RDP connection via Mstsc using a local ".rdp" file located in suspicious locations.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Likelihood is related to how often the paths are used in the environment
query: (process.executable:*\\mstsc.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:mstsc.exe) AND (process.command_line:(*.rdp OR *.rdp\")) AND (process.command_line:(*\:\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\drivers\\color* OR *\:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks_Migrated\ * OR *\:\\Windows\\Tasks\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\Tracing\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\Downloads\\*))
